title: The best places to get a little work done in Austin - candidates
method: Status/hours checked against official sites (curl + real browser for JS/blocked sites) and Google/Yelp listings on 2026-10-31; work notes only from venue sites or named reputable sources (Infatuation Nov 2025, Visit Austin, KVUE Oct 2026, CultureMap, atx-bites Sept 2026 update, CoffeeJobs 2026). Drive times: OSRM free-flow routing between OSM-geocoded addresses - real-world times longer at rush hour. Golf rates from TGI's own austin-courses dataset (read 2026-10-05). Images: own-site URLs only, each downloaded and measured 2026-10-31. No reddit used.
golf_timing_note: DST ends Sun Nov 1 2026 - sunsets move into the ~5:30-5:45pm range in November, so a twilight nine means leaving the laptop by ~3:30-4pm.

candidates.name: Austin Central Library (+ Café Crème downtown)
candidates.address: 710 W Cesar Chavez St, Austin, TX 78701
candidates.hours: Library: Sun 12-5; Mon-Thu 9am-8pm; Fri 9-5; Sat 10-5 (holiday closures listed on library site). Café Crème downtown: daily 7am-9pm.
candidates.laptop_policy: Public library - laptops welcome; no restrictions found.
candidates.wifi_outlets_seating: Free city WiFi (library.austintexas.gov/wifi). Visit Austin: six floors, indoor seating plus rooftop deck, 'excellent internet speeds'. Library lists public computers, printing from your own laptop, and bookable Shared Learning Rooms.
candidates.food_drink: Café Crème inside the building: crepes, lox bagel, breakfast tacos, crème brûlée latte (Infatuation, Nov 2025); happy hour 4-6pm.
candidates.parking: Underground garage, 140 public spaces, entrance on West Ave; not validated. First hour free, $5 up to 2 hrs, $9 up to 4, $11 up to 7 (library site).
